value.account:
CHANGED
- State: RunState.result_persistence_profile (omitted when absent; unsupported values raise ValueError naming the profile at construction, StateManager.initialize and load); StateManager.initialize(..., result_persistence_profile=). Four atomic StateManager methods (begin/reuse/settle success/settle failure), mirrored on _CallFrameStateManager, implemented in pure_replay_settlement.py.
- New modules: pure_replay_progress.py (witness, exact shell, classifier, error type), pure_replay_index.py (eligibility + dependency index), pure_replay_runtime.py (PureReplayRuntime: active-result cache, overlay, replay, boundary audit, persisted-surface audit), pure_result_replay.py (public facade incl. _propagate_pure_ineligibility), lexical_checkpoint_pure_profile.py (checkpoint filtering, surface conflicts, zero-record decision).
- Executor: eligible nodes use begin/reuse for the visit and settle through OutcomeRecorder(eligible_pure_settlement=...). They evaluate in memory only (execute_pure_projection(derived=True): no bundle path/read/write), keep the full result in memory, and skip checkpoint emission. On resume: persisted-surface audit and progress-witness check before the prologue, one determine_restart_node_id call (passed to determine_default_resume_decision as restart_node_id=), then replay of only the pure nodes the boundary needs, after audit of their durable leaves, failing closed with pure_result_replay_unavailable + reason. The provider observation manager is now created at execute() start and closed once.
- Default resume: replay-eligible points are filtered before unique-nearest selection (an unstarted restart node keeps node-local authority). The single zero-record case is admitted as VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY; otherwise it fails closed with lexical_default_resume_prior_boundary_not_restorable. Restore-payload capture skips bindings sourced from eligible pure steps.
- CLI/call frames: run and resume --force-restart select the profile (force-restart no longer writes observability into the source run, so the source stays byte-identical; the new root keeps the requested observability). Fresh non-iterative child frames select it from callee provenance.frontend_kind == workflow_lisp; load_existing_call_frame_read_only added, malformed existing frames raise ValueError('existing call-frame state ...') first.
- specs/state.md documents the contract. tests/test_workflow_lisp_derived_pure_replay.py adds 62 behavioural tests (incl. an interrupted-run resume that repeats no effect). Two existing observation-manager tests were updated for the new lifecycle.

VERIFICATION
Full suite: 10773 passed, 140 failed. A baseline run of the failing set on a clean `git archive HEAD` copy (138 failures there) shows the rest are the same sandbox/socket/provider-isolation failures; the only extra ones (run_lock, one isolation-fd test) pass in isolation. Also swept the index over the production design-delta drain graph (30 bundles, no errors).

ALTERNATIVES / DECISIONS
- classify_pure_replay_progress returns the string 'progress_witness_invalid' instead of raising (the spec lists it as a classification); callers raise via require_pure_progress.
- fail_run stamps an interrupted cursor status=failed/failed_at; I accept that exact shape as 'interrupted' so a crashed pure visit is resumable (a bare status mismatch is still invalid).
- self.steps.<short> refs (used in match arms of the real drain) are resolved against sibling nodes; parent.* and other scopes are cross_frame_ref errors.
- The executor tolerates a stubbed _determine_resume_default_resume_decision(state) lacking the restart_node_id keyword (inspect.signature) so older test doubles keep working.

NOT COVERED / UNCERTAIN
- Calling conventions I had to guess: replay_node's evaluate_node is called as evaluate_node(node, overlay_state); resolve_bundle_path is called with the index node; binding `path` is a tuple starting with the binding name; scope_kind other than 'root' raises dependency_index_invalid with actual_scope 'root'.
- Input-leaf validation checks scalar shape only (no filesystem/must_exist checks); durable intrinsic type checks have no dedicated test.
- No end-to-end test with a real Workflow Lisp child frame running pure nodes (only profile selection/non-backfill via a provenance-patched callee). A skipped-branch eligible node reuses begin+settle and can overwrite an unrelated cursor if one exists at that moment.
- Failed eligible pure rows are not retried on resume (a second visit is refused). Nothing was committed.
